purpose: Independent downstream PLACE rolls conditioned on already-resolved cause/detail, including age/sex-conditioned toxicology settings where published evidence supports them. Event setting and terminal place are kept semantically distinct in metadata but rendered through one compact PLACE field.
probability_semantics: Each distribution is conditional on the trigger cause and country/profile shown. Source counts/percentages are normalized only within the stated source population. PLACE never changes mortality, cause, cause detail, suicide context, X80 location, X41 drug class, or seasonality.
